name: irminsul-monorepo
description: Monorepo Irminsul — apps web (Next.js) + desktop (Tauri) + packages partagés. Le moteur Python reste sous services/engine (préservé).

scripts.test: npm run test -w @irminsul/data-access && npm run test -w @irminsul/engine-client && npm run test -w @irminsul/ui
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:py && npm run test && npm run test:py && npm run build && npm run check:proxy
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:prepare && npm --prefix app run tauri:build
